messages.author: a3527f6489543e9b
messages.subject: Part 5 error for GGIR 3.0.3
parts:
Dear GGIR community

I hope everyone is doing well. I am currently processing some Actigraph accelerometer data (wrist-worn) using the most recent version of GGIR (3.0.3). I got through Parts 1 to 4 without any issues; however, for Part 5, I got the following error for a large proportion of data files:
 Errors and warnings for CRO2300012501 (2023-11-27).gt3x.RData$message
[1] "missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed"

$call
if (HMS[length(HMS)] != lastepoch) HMS = c(HMS, lastepoch)

When I checked the metadata folder and the output Excel documents, I saw data produced for all participants for Parts 1 to 4. The calibration errors and the number of valid days also look fine for all files (all with at least 5 days of data recorded). So I suspect the errors lie in Part 5? I have attached the metadata for two data files I am having issues with and the config. file to help with the investigation. 

P/S: I just re-processed all the data files on another computer with an older version of GGIR installed, and I was able to get the data for all participants without any errors. 


Thank you.

Best regards,
John.

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Part 5 error for GGIR 3.0.3
parts:
Dear John,

Thanks for reporting this and for providing the example files. I see this is a bug, specific to timewindow = "MM" for recordings that start at midnight, and for which the first and last day are incomplete.

To try out the fix I just prepared install GGIR with:
remotes::install_github("wadpac/GGIR", ref = "issue1029_definedays")

Let me know if you encounter any problems.

Best,

Vincent

messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Part 5 error for GGIR 3.0.3
parts:
Hi All,
One of my colleagues has this error in part 5 (mentioned below), but with the same script and GGIR version 3.0.5, I don't have an error. Moreover, my colleague is working on Linux and is not able to install remotes::install_github("wadpac/GGIR", ref = "issue1029_definedays") it as suggested. However, I am working on Windows, and everything works for me and do not have any error messages.

Moreover, even with this error, my colleague got all outputs as expected, such as raw CSV files in the meta folder for part 5. Could anyone suggest if we should ignore this error or if this message has any significance?



Regards, 

Abdul Haleem

messages.author: 05de4f382b390d3d
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Part 5 error for GGIR 3.0.3
parts:
Hi,

Just want to point out that the branch "issue1029_definedays" was already merged into the master branch and is part of GGIR 3.0-5, so just installing GGIR as usual ("install.packages("GGIR")) would update GGIR to version 3.0-5 and would have the fixes introduced in the previous branch. If, after updating GGIR, you do not get any error, then I think we can assume that everything is fine.

Best,
Jairo
